card.name: Inside lists of adverse-event terms
card.fires_on: Linking words, commas and word endings inside lists or headings of medical adverse-event terms, such as neurological symptoms or named syndromes. It fires just before the next term in the list.

modes.label: Commas in symptom lists
modes.description: A comma after a neurological symptom term, in a run of symptoms.
modes.example: generalized muscle weakness, diplopia, ptosis<<,>> dysphagia, dysphonia

modes.label: Linking words in condition headings
modes.description: The word 'and' or 'including' joining condition names in a warning heading or sentence.
modes.example: 5.2 Lactic Acidosis<< and>> Severe Hepatomegaly with

modes.label: Partway through a symptom term
modes.description: The start or end of a long medical word or severity grade within a symptom list.

card.plain: It marks the spot in a list of side-effect terms where another symptom or condition name comes next.
